title: CostItemSchema
description: Schema for individual TradeOS cost items

id.description: Unique identifier of the cost item

name.description: Descriptive title of the cost item in Title Case

category.description: Standard trade category matching the trade taxonomy

provenanceStatus.description: Trust state of this item's pricing, shared with the relational Costbook's candidate-ingestion vocabulary (app/modules/costbook/provenance.ts). 'documented' means a recorded source, date, and human review pass exist; do not set it without those. Absent is normalized by the app to 'unverified-legacy', never treated as 'documented' by omission.

sourceName.description: Human-readable name of the source this price traces to (e.g. a manufacturer price sheet, a public cost index). Required alongside sourceUrl/sourceIdentifier when provenanceStatus is 'documented'.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the cited source, when it has one. Do not cite a licensed/proprietary dataset (e.g. RSMeans) this project has no right to reproduce.

sourceIdentifier.description: Non-URL identifier for the source (a document name, catalog number, internal reference), when sourceUrl does not apply.

sourceDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the cited source itself states or was published, distinct from retrievedAt.

retrievedAt.description: ISO timestamp this value was collected/generated, distinct from the source's own sourceDate.

confidence.description: Qualitative research confidence in this specific value, distinct from the existing numeric confidenceScore (a different, pre-existing field).

reviewedBy.description: Named human reviewer identifier. Never a synthetic value like "AI"/"system"/a model name - mirrors the relational Costbook's reviewed-candidate identity rule.

reviewedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the human review recorded in reviewedBy.

x-future-extensions.regional_modifiers: Hook to apply geographic multipliers to labor and material rates
x-future-extensions.index_indexing: Binds cost components to external indices like BLS or commodity feeds
